verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a solutions-page claim that Mistral offers on-premises/self-hosted deployment for compliance-first organizations and maintains a Trust Center, which implies some data-residency control but does not document actual region selection (e.g., EU vs US hosting options) within Document AI itself. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection settings in the API or console, documentation of specific data center locations, and independent confirmation that self-hosting satisfies residency requirements.
